name: arrow
whatItDemonstrates: A contextual song menu with an arrow visually connecting the popup to its trigger.
nonTrivialInteractions: sideOffset is passed as a function of side (12 when positioned on top, 8 otherwise)
Menu.Arrow repositions and rotates automatically per popup side via data-side selectors
items highlight on hover/keyboard focus via data-highlighted

name: checkbox-items
whatItDemonstrates: A workspace settings menu whose three checkbox items each toggle a boolean preference (minimap, search, sidebar).
stateManaged: uncontrolled — menu open state is unmanaged; three separate React useState booleans (showMinimap/showSearch/showSidebar) drive each CheckboxItem's checked/onCheckedChange
nonTrivialInteractions: checking an item toggles its controlled checked state and renders a CheckIcon through Menu.CheckboxItemIndicator
menu stays open when toggling a checkbox item (CheckboxItem does not close on click by default)

name: detached-triggers-controlled
whatItDemonstrates: Three detached triggers sharing one handle-driven menu whose open state and active trigger are controlled externally, including programmatic opening from a plain button.
stateManaged: controlled — useState open + useState activeTrigger wired to Menu.Root open/onOpenChange/triggerId; a plain <button> sets both directly (activeTrigger='menu-trigger-2', open=true) to open the playback menu programmatically
nonTrivialInteractions: three Menu.Triggers live outside Menu.Root, joined by a shared Menu.createHandle<MenuKey>() handle
each trigger passes a distinct payload ('library' | 'playback' | 'share'); Menu.Root's function child maps that payload to an item-group definition
onOpenChange reads eventDetails.trigger.id to sync the activeTrigger state only when opening
Menu.Root triggerId aligns the popup to the trigger that opened it, matching the trigger id props
each Menu.Item has its own onClick handler (console.log)
discrepancies: Trivial non-styling divergence: the 'Copy link' item's onClick console.log text is 'Copying' in the tailwind variant (`docs/src/app/(docs)/react/components/menu/demos/detached-triggers-controlled/tailwind/index.tsx:22`) but 'Copying link' in the css-modules variant (`docs/src/app/(docs)/react/components/menu/demos/detached-triggers-controlled/css-modules/index.tsx:18`). Remaining differences are typing-only (MenuItemDefinition interface + `as MenuItemDefinition[]` vs `as const`); otherwise behaviorally identical.

name: detached-triggers-full
whatItDemonstrates: Detached triggers with per-trigger payloads animating the menu's position, size, and content (via Menu.Viewport) as it moves between triggers.
stateManaged: uncontrolled — no React state; open state handled by Menu.Root and popup content varies by trigger payload read through the function child
nonTrivialInteractions: three detached triggers with distinct typed payloads drive one non-modal menu (modal={false})
Positioner transitions top/left/right/bottom and Popup transitions width/height over 0.35s so the menu animates between trigger positions and sizes (data-instant disables transitions)
Positioner/Popup are sized from --positioner-width/--positioner-height and --popup-width/--popup-height CSS variables to freeze measurement during transitions
Menu.Viewport renders per-payload content with data-current/data-previous containers and data-activation-direction tokens for direction-aware cross-fade
content per payload: heading GroupLabel rendered only in the first group, Separators between groups

name: detached-triggers-simple
whatItDemonstrates: An icon-only detached trigger opening a handle-joined menu rendered elsewhere in the tree.
stateManaged: uncontrolled — no React state at all
nonTrivialInteractions: icon-only Menu.Trigger with aria-label sits outside Menu.Root; a shared Menu.createHandle() joins them
Delete item is styled as destructive (red text in the tailwind variant only)

name: group-labels
whatItDemonstrates: A view menu combining a labeled radio group ('Sort') and a labeled group of checkbox items ('Workspace') in one popup.
stateManaged: uncontrolled — menu open state unmanaged; radio selection via useState('date') + setValue through RadioGroup value/onValueChange; three useState booleans for the checkbox items
nonTrivialInteractions: one GroupLabel labels the RadioGroup and another labels the plain Group
single radio selection coexists with independently togglable checkbox items
Separator between the radio and checkbox sections

name: hero
whatItDemonstrates: The canonical song context menu: a trigger opening a popup of plain items separated into sections.
nonTrivialInteractions: menu opens on trigger click and closes when an item is activated (default close behavior)
keyboard navigation/highlighting across items with non-focusable separators

name: open-on-hover
whatItDemonstrates: A playlist menu that opens when the trigger is hovered instead of clicked.
nonTrivialInteractions: openOnHover opens the menu on trigger hover without click
items still close the menu on activation (default close behavior)

name: radio-items
whatItDemonstrates: A sort menu whose radio group single-selects between date, name, and type.
stateManaged: uncontrolled — menu open state unmanaged; radio selection via useState('date') passed to RadioGroup value/onValueChange
nonTrivialInteractions: selecting a RadioItem updates the controlled radio value and moves the check indicator (RadioItemIndicator renders CheckIcon only for the checked item)

name: submenu
whatItDemonstrates: A song menu containing a nested submenu opened from a SubmenuTrigger item.
nonTrivialInteractions: Menu.SubmenuTrigger opens a nested menu with its own Portal/Positioner/Popup inside SubmenuRoot
submenu Positioner offsets are computed by getOffset: 4 for top/bottom sides, -4 for left/right
submenu trigger keeps a persistent highlight while its popup is open (data-popup-open)
discrepancies: Non-styling content divergence: the submenu popup items differ between variants — tailwind mirrors the parent menu items ('Add to Library', 'Add to Playlist', separator, 'Play Next', 'Play Last', separator, 'Favorite', 'Share') (`docs/src/app/(docs)/react/components/menu/demos/submenu/tailwind/index.tsx:26-35`), while css-modules shows playlist items ('Get Up!', 'Inside Out', 'Night Beats', separator, 'New playlist…') (`docs/src/app/(docs)/react/components/menu/demos/submenu/css-modules/index.tsx:28-34`). Same parts and interactions; only the demo copy and separator count differ.
